reviewer: Hamza Kani (hkani@nitda.gov.ng), technical owner, reviewed the 43 samples sent 2026-10-16
acceptedBy: the owner, Office of the Director-General/CEO (dgsregistry@nitda.gov.ng), who directed the replacement set be implemented as the closure of ITEM-68 (2026-10-18)
findings: templates not designed to the brand and design system in use
the logo missing from some templates
no greeting to the recipient in some bodies
the same colour used by two or more different notices
resolution: The owner-supplied set (Comprehensive Portfolio Brand System Package) replaces all 43 templates: a Deep Green masthead with the white NITDA lockup on every message, the DGO Digital Ops logo on internal mail, a greeting in every body, colour by purpose so no two kinds of notice share a scheme, and one layout system. Logos are served only from https://correspondence-gateway.rf.gd/email-assets/ (owner decision 2026-10-18), deployed with the Portal package. Three colours outside the brand tokens were mapped to the nearest tokens (#E1DFE0 to ink-100, #EEEDED to ink-50, #00575C to info-800); two expressions longer than one build part were split with identical output. Identification release 36 applied to all 21 sending flows.
evidence: npm run test:emailcatalogue: every package body is its catalogue template; 48 of 48 messages pass every template check (the one recipient finding is a fixed address in the scan flow, not part of the template set)
docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/evidence/2026-10-18-template-release-proof.json: live sends composed by the new templates without error, receipts 1632, 1633, 1635, 1637
